environment: Actual Electron desktop with commissioned personal runtime
fault_injection: SIGSTOP on verified idle supervisor; SIGCONT in finally after 45 seconds. No task was running.
observations: Desktop screenshot showed Reconnecting while server was paused.
Desktop returned automatically to connected local Settings without reload or manual reconnect.
Runtime installation identity and lifecycle revision remained unchanged; completed task IDs and statuses survived.
Worker PID after recovery was 29589, replacing pre-check worker 26419. Recovery was not same-worker continuity.
finding: During disconnection the app replaces the connected settings interface with the legacy dark General settings interface. Keep the selected product surface and appearance stable while reconnecting; do not treat cached services as execution authority.
limitations: This verifies an idle 45-second server interruption, not in-flight task cancellation, lease expiry, or machine/network failure.
Native accessibility snapshots remained stale during the transition; rendered screenshots establish the visible states.
The outage interface regression remains open.
